subject: System Design
title: PostgreSQL vs MySQL
description: A quick win: understand PostgreSQL vs MySQL.

hook.text: PostgreSQL and MySQL are both relational databases. But they have very different philosophies.

buildup.text: MySQL prioritizes simplicity and speed for web apps. PostgreSQL prioritizes correctness and extensibility.

discovery.text: PostgreSQL supports JSON, arrays, custom types, and advanced SQL features that MySQL lacks.

twist.text: MySQL's replication ecosystem is more mature. Many large-scale systems still prefer MySQL for this reason.

climax.text: Neither is universally better. PostgreSQL leads in features; MySQL leads in operational simplicity.

punchline.text: PostgreSQL for features, MySQL for operational simplicity.

quiz.question: What is PostgreSQL's main strength over MySQL?
options: Advanced features like JSON, arrays, and custom types
